_note: Wooden farm tools: hoes, spades, rakes and forks cut and shaped from seasoned timber. The tool a farm worker draws when iron tools are short (data/world/trades.json tool_basket order). Every figure is a labelled heuristic with a retire field naming Complaint 659; no source was opened.

wooden_tools_kg.basis: per tonne of finished wooden farm tools (hoes, spades, rakes, forks, sickle handles), counted by the mass of the tools
wooden_tools_kg.yield_basis: LABELLED HEURISTIC (conf D), no source found for the timber a tonne of wooden tools takes nor for the carpenter hours. Hewing a blade or tine from a log wastes most of it and green wood is part water, so a tonne of tools is taken to start as three tonnes of green roundwood (wood_kg); shaping each tool by axe, adze and knife is taken as about two hours a kilogram (author's estimate; retire: Complaint 659). Needs no technology.
